summary: Frontend-only verification of Settings → Assign Shifts tab. All 5 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) default listing shows only 47 active employees with 0 inactive badges; (2) searching 'Mohammed Hamza' returns 1 row for inactive employee EMP0002 with visible 'Inactive' badge (data-testid='assign-inactive-badge-<id>'); (3) clearing the search reverts to 47 active-only rows and the previously shown inactive employee disappears; (4) each employee appears exactly once (47 unique assign-row testids, 47 current-shift cells) and Current Shift shows a single latest value (e.g., Mid Shift (13:30) for Hamza, AI Research Unit-New (10:30) for most); (5) existing controls render and are operable — Shift select, Effective From date (18-Sep-2026), Effective To, Departments/Teams/Designations filters, 'Bulk Assign by Filter' and 'Assign Selected (0)' buttons. Active Assignments table renders 67 unique rows (data-testid starting 'active-assignment-'). No mutations performed.
critical_code_review_comments: Employees list initially shows a spinner for ~1-2s before rows render; consider a lightweight skeleton or aria-busy hint (nice-to-have).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AssignShiftsTab wiring to GET /api/settings/shifts/assignable-employees is correct end-to-end. Debounced search (~0.5s) works; server returns single latest-shift row per employee and honors search-includes-inactive. Active Assignments table populated with latest_per_employee=true (67 rows). Login page briefly shows disabled 'Initializing...' button — wait for 'Sign In' before filling.
